ROLE: Decide whether a byte slice is a legal MQTT Topic Name: at least one character, at most 65535 encoded bytes, no wildcard byte, well-formed UTF-8 without U+0000.

FUNC.NAME: topic_utf8_validate
FUNC.ROLE: Well-formedness and U+0000 check on the same slice

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: topic_utf8_validate
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 when the slice is well-formed UTF-8 with no U+0000; 0 otherwise
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: no ownership; the slice is only read
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: no failure mode other than returning 0; a 0 result means the whole name is rejected

LOGIC.INPUT: name points to len caller-owned bytes of a decoded PUBLISH Topic Name field; name may be NULL only when len is 0.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) Reject len == 0 (a Topic Name must be at least one character, MQTT-4.7.3-1). 2) Reject len > 65535 (an encoded string cannot exceed 65535 bytes, MQTT-4.7.3-3). 3) Reject name == NULL. 4) Scan every byte: reject 0x23 ('#') and 0x2B ('+') because wildcard characters MUST NOT appear in a Topic Name (MQTT-4.7.1-1). 5) Return topic_utf8_validate(name, len): this rejects ill-formed UTF-8 and any encoding of U+0000. No normalization, case folding or character substitution is performed; a name consisting only of '/' is legal and distinct levels are preserved.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 1 when the slice is a legal Topic Name; 0 otherwise. The slice is never modified.
INVARIANTS_USED: case sensitive, spaces and empty levels are legal
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: name is NULL with len == 0 or points to len readable bytes.
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: the slice is unmodified and the result depends only on its bytes and length

EXPECT.note: empty levels, a lone slash and the '$' names are legal Topic Names
